objective: Close the producer -> consumer e2e seam with regression tests: extend tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py with the committed cases test_pipeline_e2e_both_keys_timeout_ms_wins (timeout_ms=500 + timeout=123 -> 500) and test_pipeline_e2e_default_timeout_ms_reaches_consumer (make_job without an explicit timeout_ms argument -> job_timeout returns 30000), and verify the entire suite (producer, consumer, engine, e2e) passes with engine semantics unchanged and no existing test case modified.

concepts: producer -> consumer pass-through of the same job dict (no serializer); primary-path jobs must be built via producer.make_job for wire-path fidelity
the two pre-existing e2e test methods must stay byte-identical; new cases are additive inside the existing test file
engine status literals 'done'/'timeout' with the strict > comparison are frozen (C1); no new engine assertions beyond the existing engine e2e case
tests/test_consumer.py shows which resolution behaviors are already pinned at unit level (legacy fallback 123, default 30000), so the e2e layer must not duplicate them

inputs: T01 output: pipeline/consumer.py with job_timeout resolving timeout_ms first (consumed by the new e2e cases, never patched by them)
frozen contract C1 (job wire schema) and C2 (resolution order) from stage-contract.json

frozen_contracts.spec_ref: stage-contract.json shared_contracts[C1] - job wire schema; producer/engine frozen as-is
stage-contract.json shared_contracts[C2] - resolution order timeout_ms -> 'timeout' -> DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS

allowed_dependencies.what: the fixed pipeline/consumer.py job_timeout behavior - the new e2e cases assert it; T02 consumes the behavior, it does not re-implement or patch it

non_goals: no change to any pipeline/ module - if the suite is red after T01, that is a T01 defect or a CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST against C2, not T02 work
no modification, rename, or skip of the two pre-existing e2e test methods
no edits to tests/test_producer.py or tests/test_consumer.py (owned by T01 / untouched)
no e2e duplication of the legacy-fallback (123) and default (30000) unit-level cases beyond the committed default-reaches-consumer wire case
no new test files and no new dependencies
implementation_constraints: additive only: new test methods test_pipeline_e2e_both_keys_timeout_ms_wins and test_pipeline_e2e_default_timeout_ms_reaches_consumer inside the existing TestPipelineE2E class (or a new class in the same file); the two existing methods stay byte-identical
primary-path jobs are built via producer.make_job (wire path); hand-crafted dicts are allowed only where the seam boundary requires a job shape the producer does not emit (the both-keys case)
run the suite from the repo root: python -m pytest tests/
at task close, all pipeline/ modules and both unit test files must be byte-identical to the state left by T01
